answer_1.quote: For low-entropy scenarios, we target at the task of code generation by adopting two datasets following , HumanEval  and MBPP .
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates code and news reports using LLMs, with watermarked outputs for detection evaluation.

answer_2.quote: Before detection, we measure the generation quality of all generated texts. Specifically, we are able to achieve 31.0% and 30.4% in pass@1  for the HumanEval and MBPP dataset, respectively, comparable to Lee et al. ( )'s. For the Rotowire and C4 dataset, our generated output can achieve 7.24 and 3.25 in text perplexity (PPL) using OPT-6.7B .
